Based on a full-corpus search, **no document provides for arbitration seated in Singapore**. A direct query for "Singapore" returned `absent` across all 120 indexed pages/documents in the corpus.

The only arbitration seat clause found is in **msa-2019.pdf, p.16** (§14.3), which states: *"Any dispute shall be finally resolved by arbitration seated in **London** under the LCIA"* — not Singapore.

NOT FOUND (for Singapore specifically) — searched the full corpus (`ow_query: "Singapore"`, `"SIAC Singapore International Arbitration Centre"`, and governing-law/arbitration clauses generally) with no matches for Singapore as a seat; the only seated-arbitration clause located is London/LCIA in msa-2019.pdf p.16.
